verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own deployment tracking for spotting new errors or regressions per deployment, and errors can be filtered by version. That touches release regression monitoring, but nothing documents crash-free session or user rates, adoption per release, or a canary-versus-stable comparison. Missing for 10: crash-free sessions/users metrics, per-release adoption tracking, side-by-side canary vs last-stable release comparison, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can watch release health — crash-free sessions and users, adoption per release — and compare a canary release against the last stable one

citations.quote: Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.
